meta.source: Energy Trust of Oregon, Water Heater Serial Number Decoder (2025); Bradford White, Determine the Age of My Water Heater
meta.notes: Only brands whose format we could confirm in an opened source are listed. Patterns are tried in order. Two-digit years take the latest matching year that is not in the future. Letter-year codes repeat every 20 years, so the decoder returns the latest year and lists the earlier ones; the unit's look and the dates on its labels settle which is right. Tankless brands (Rinnai, Navien, Noritz, Takagi, Bosch) are not listed yet; for them, and whenever a serial does not match, the calculator asks for the manufacture year. Rheem and Ruud also offer their own lookup, which beats any decoder.

bradford-white.label: Bradford White
bradford-white.source: Bradford White: first two characters of the serial are the year and month (year letters exclude I, O, Q, R, U, V; month letters A to M exclude I); Energy Trust of Oregon gives the earlier cycles (A = 1964, 1984, 2004)

patterns.example: DF******* → June 1967, 1987, 2007 or 2027 (latest not in the future)

rheem.label: Rheem / Ruud
rheem.source: Energy Trust of Oregon: Rheem uses a two-digit month followed by a two-digit year (example 0794****** = July 1994)

ao-smith.label: A. O. Smith
ao-smith.source: Energy Trust of Oregon: since 2008, an 11-character serial whose first two positions are the year followed by a two-digit week (example 0805A…); before 2008 the second letter is the month (A to N, no I) followed by a two-digit year (example *H06… = August 2006)

state.label: State
state.source: Energy Trust of Oregon: since 2008 State uses the A. O. Smith code (two-digit year, two-digit week); before 2008 a one-letter month (A to N, no I) followed by a two-digit year (example C05… = March 2005)

patterns.example: 0904******* → 2009, week 4 (Energy Trust labels this example April 2009, which does not match its own year-week rule; we follow the rule)

american.label: American
american.source: Energy Trust of Oregon: American uses a two-digit year followed by a two-digit week (example 9746****** = week 46 of 1997); American has been part of A. O. Smith since 2001 and makes the Whirlpool brand
